tools.name: current_weather
tools.description: Get selected current weather measurements for any location using latitude and longitude. Known location examples: Faro, Portugal (37.0187, -7.9272); Lisbon, Portugal (38.7223, -9.1393); London, United Kingdom (51.5074, -0.1278). These are examples, not a location allowlist. Choose one or more supported measurements using the current argument. Forecast days is fixed at 1. No API key is required.

latitude.description: Location latitude in decimal degrees. North is positive; south is negative.

longitude.description: Location longitude in decimal degrees. East is positive; west is negative.

current.description: One or more comma-separated measurement names, without spaces: rain, precipitation, temperature_2m, relative_humidity_2m, apparent_temperature, weather_code, wind_speed_10m, wind_direction_10m. For example: temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,rain. Pass a string, not an array.
Contains the requested measurements and timing metadata. Unrequested measurements are absent; unavailable values may be null.

temperature_2m.description: Air temperature at 2 metres, in Celsius.

relative_humidity_2m.description: Relative humidity at 2 metres, in percent.

wind_speed_10m.description: Wind speed at 10 metres, in kilometres per hour.

wind_direction_10m.description: Wind direction at 10 metres, in degrees.

current_units.description: Units reported by Open-Meteo for the requested measurements and timing metadata.
